Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-c110pchopper022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/c110pchopper.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Light/large/c110pchopper.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). * '''PC-E1''' ([[C1-10P (Chopper) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 11 July 2022<ref name="img-c110pchopper1d114e1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/c110pchopper.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/1d114e11aef35680bc775029d4203d1eae714fad commit 1d114e1] (11 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Light/large/c110pchopper.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
